source_guard: Complete numerical/transport/angular source replay before output; regenerated C/CM byte-identical to verified case; all lower states accounted.
observability: Isolated copied SFAC frontend adds raw API queries, unchanged pinned FAC library/executable/source. Keep standard tables, native API statuses, constants and exact derived diff. No nonzero-status zero fill.
missing_channel_policy: No complete lifetime from missing/unresolved channels. Only explicit native values or independently justified minimal-basis angular zeros count.
model_scope: Minimal configurations and nuclear/potential/optimization differences retained; shared angular converter, independent FAC Hamiltonian. No calibration or experimental fitting.
failure_policy: Stop and retain changed inputs/library, native refusal, unmet numerical criterion or incomplete queries; no fallback.
database_protocol: Single rates.tr.b per process, six explicit multipole blocks, one final PrintTable
retained_failure: runs/fac_model_rates_v20: one-DB-file-per-session protocol error, no physical-model change
